about: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) is Kuwait's state-owned oil company, controlling upstream production, refining, petrochemicals, tankers and international marketing through subsidiaries such as Kuwait Oil Company, Kuwait National Petroleum Company and Kuwait Petroleum International, which runs the Q8 brand across Europe. Wholly owned by the government of Kuwait. Customers are refiners, traders and drivers at Q8 stations. Not listed. Q8 is a recognised fuel brand in parts of Europe.

wiki.title: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation
wiki.text: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation is Kuwait's national state-owned oil company, headquartered in Kuwait City.

about: Ecopetrol is Colombia's largest integrated oil and gas company, operating production, refining, pipelines through Cenit, petrochemicals and renewable energy, with ISA transmission networks as a subsidiary and operations in Brazil, Peru and the US Permian Basin. Headquartered in Bogota, with the Colombian government holding about 88 percent. Listed on the Colombian exchange (ECOPETROL) and NYSE (EC). Revenue is around $30 billion. Well-known national brand with a history of sports sponsorship in Colombia.

wiki.title: Ecopetrol
wiki.text: Ecopetrol, formerly known as Empresa Colombiana de Petróleo S.A., is the largest and primary petroleum company in Colombia. As a result of its continuous growth, Ecopetrol forms part of the Fortune Global 500 and was ranked 346. In the 2020 Forbes Global 2000, Ecopetrol was ranked as the 313th -largest public company in the world. It was ranked 303 in 2012 by CNN Money.

about: Neste is a Finnish refiner and a leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel from waste and residue oils, with refineries in Finland, the Netherlands and Singapore, plus oil products and polymer solutions. Customers are airlines, fuel distributors, transport companies and chemical makers, with revenue of about 20 billion euros. Headquartered in Espoo, with the Finnish state owning about 44 percent. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki (NESTE). Well known in Finland and a long-time rally sponsor, including Rally Finland.

wiki.title: Neste
wiki.text: Neste Oyj is an oil refining and marketing company located in Espoo, Finland. It produces, refines and markets oil products, provides engineering services, and licenses production technologies. Neste has operations in 14 countries.

about: Orlen, formerly PKN Orlen, is a Polish multi-energy group that operates refineries and petrochemical plants, produces oil and gas, generates power, and runs about 3,000 fuel stations in Poland, Germany, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary and Lithuania. It merged with Lotos and PGNiG in 2022. Headquartered in Plock, with the Polish state as the largest shareholder. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (PKN). Strong consumer fuel brand in Poland with a history in motorsport, including Robert Kubica and Alfa Romeo Racing Orlen.

wiki.title: Orlen
wiki.what: Polish oil refiner and petrol retailer
wiki.text: Orlen SA (formerly PKN Orlen SA, commonly known as Orlen is a Polish multinational oil refiner, petrol retailer and natural gas trader headquartered in Płock, Poland. The company's subsidiaries include the main oil and gas companies of the Czechia and Lithuania, Unipetrol and Orlen Lietuva, respectively.

about: YPF is Argentina's largest energy company, producing oil and gas, notably from the Vaca Muerta shale formation, refining, selling fuels at its national network of YPF service stations and Elaion lubricants, and operating petrochemicals and power. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, with the Argentine state owning about 51 percent after the 2012 renationalisation. Listed on NYSE (YPF) and BYMA. Very visible consumer fuel brand in Argentina with long ties to national motorsport.

wiki.title: YPF
wiki.text: YPF S.A. is a vertically integrated, majority state-owned Argentine energy company, engaged in oil and gas exploration and production, and the transportation, refining, and marketing of gas and petroleum products. In the 2020 Forbes Global 2000, YPF was ranked as the 1360th largest public company in the world.

about: Vienna-based integrated oil, gas and chemicals group, owner of Borealis and Borouge, with fuel stations in Central Europe. Majority-owned by Austrian ÖBAG and ADNOC. Listed in Vienna. Consumer-facing in Austria. Operates refineries and about 2,000 filling stations under OMV and Avanti brands in Central and Eastern Europe. Revenue about EUR 40 billion; high consumer visibility in Austria and neighbouring countries.

wiki.title: OMV
wiki.text: OMV, formerly an abbreviation for Österreichische Mineralölverwaltung Aktiengesellschaft (ÖMV), is the major integrated oil- and gas company in Austria with business activities, including fuels & feedstock, petrochemicals, and energy.

about: Budapest-based Hungarian oil, gas and fuel retail group, operating refineries and about 2,000 filling stations in Central and Eastern Europe. Listed in Budapest (MOL). Revenue is about EUR 20 billion. Strong consumer brand in Hungary and neighbouring countries. Operates in Hungary, Slovakia, Croatia, Romania and other markets, with about 25,000 employees. MOL is also active in petrochemicals and has exploration assets in Azerbaijan, Kurdistan and elsewhere, and its fuel stations are present across eleven countries.

wiki.title: MOL (company)
wiki.what: Hungarian Oil and Gas Public Limited Company
wiki.text: MOL Plc., also known as MOL Group, is a Hungarian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Budapest, Hungary. Members of MOL Group include among others the Croatian and Slovak formerly state-owned oil and gas companies, INA and Slovnaft. MOL is Hungary's second most profitable enterprise, with net profits of $810 million in 2025. The company is also the third most valuable company in Central and Eastern Europe and placed 402 on the Fortune Global 500 list of the world's largest companies in 2013.

about: Pemex (Petroleos Mexicanos) is Mexico's state-owned oil and gas company, headquartered in Mexico City, that explores, refines and distributes crude oil, natural gas and petrochemicals, and operates the Pemex fuel station franchise network. It is among the world's most indebted oil companies and a large contributor to government revenue. Mexican consumers know it through its petrol stations. Employees number over 100,000. Government-owned, with a history of sponsorship in Mexican sport and motorsport, including with Sergio Perez.

wiki.title: Pemex
wiki.text: Pemex is the Mexican state-owned petroleum corporation managed and operated by the Mexican government. It was formed in 1938 by nationalization and expropriation of all private oil companies in Mexico at the time of its formation, making PEMEX an enduring symbol of Mexican nationalism. Pemex had total assets worth $101.8 billion in December 2019 and as of 2009 was Latin America's second-largest enterprise by annual revenue, surpassed only by Petrobras. The company is the seventh-most polluting in the world according to The Guardian.

about: Dangote Petroleum Refinery is a 650,000-barrel-per-day oil refinery and petrochemical complex in the Lekki Free Zone near Lagos, Nigeria, owned by Aliko Dangote's Dangote Industries and the largest single-train refinery in the world. It began producing petrol and diesel in 2024 and 2025, supplying the Nigerian market and exporting. Construction cost about 20 billion dollars. The Dangote name is very widely known in Nigeria and across Africa, and the group has sponsored major sports.

Equinor is Norway's state-controlled energy company, headquartered in Stavanger, a major producer of oil and natural gas on the Norwegian continental shelf, with a growing offshore wind and low-carbon business. It was formerly Statoil, renamed in 2018 and is listed on Oslo and the NYSE (EQNR), with the Norwegian state holding about two-thirds. Revenue is over 100 billion dollars. Sells fuel to consumers in Norway through retail stations and has been a sports sponsor, including cycling and football.

wiki.title: Equinor
wiki.text: Equinor ASA is a Norwegian multinational energy company headquartered in Stavanger, Norway. It is primarily a petroleum company operating in 36 countries with additional investments in renewable energy and lithium mining. In the 2020 Forbes Global 2000, Equinor was ranked as the 169th-largest public company in the world. In 2023, the company was ranked 52nd in the same list. As of 2021, the company has 21,126 employees.

about: Scottish-headquartered British energy company in Perth, with major businesses in renewables, networks, thermal power and energy supply. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (SSE) and a FTSE 100 member. Serves millions of UK and Irish customers. Consumer-facing brand with high UK awareness; it has sponsored sports and the COP26 conference.

CK Hutchison Holdings is a Hong Kong conglomerate founded by Li Ka-shing, with ports (Hutchison Ports), retail (A.S. Watson, with Watsons and Superdrug), infrastructure (UK Power Networks, Northumbrian Water), telecom (Three, Hutchison) and energy investments, in about 50 countries with 300,000 employees. Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (0001). Watsons and Superdrug are consumer brands, though the group itself is B2B.

wiki.title: CK Hutchison Holdings
wiki.text: CK Hutchison Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong–based and Cayman Islands–registered multinational conglomerate corporation. The company was formed in March 2015 through the merger of Cheung Kong Holdings and its main associate company Hutchison Whampoa. It has four core businesses – ports and related services, retail, infrastructure and telecommunications – which operate in over 50 countries, as well as several other investments around the world.

about: NextPower, formerly Nextracker, is a Fremont, California maker of solar tracker systems and software that rotate panels to follow the sun, selling to utility-scale solar developers and EPCs worldwide. Spun out of Flex, listed on Nasdaq (NXT) in 2023, and it renamed itself NextPower in 2025. Revenue is around $2.5 billion. B2B clean energy hardware, little consumer brand awareness.

SOCAR (State Oil Company of the Azerbaijan Republic) is the national oil and gas company of Azerbaijan, headquartered in Baku, covering exploration, production, refining, petrochemicals, gas distribution and international fuel retail through SOCAR Energy brand sites in Georgia, Switzerland, Turkey and elsewhere. Wholly state-owned. SOCAR has been a prominent sponsor, including at Baku's European Games and football and motorsport events, so it has strong brand visibility for sponsors.

wiki.title: SOCAR
wiki.what: State-owned oil and gas company in Azerbaijan
wiki.text: The State Oil Company of the Republic of Azerbaijan, largely known by its abbreviation SOCAR, is a fully state-owned national oil and gas company headquartered in Baku, Azerbaijan. The company produces oil and natural gas from onshore and offshore fields in the Azerbaijani segment of the Caspian Sea. It operates the country's only oil refinery, one gas processing plant and runs several oil and gas export pipelines throughout the country. It owns fuel filling station networks under the SOCAR brand in Azerbaijan, Turkey, Georgia, Ukraine, Romania, Switzerland, and Austria.

about: Ampol is an Australian fuel supplier and convenience retailer headquartered in Sydney (Alexandria), formerly Caltex Australia, running the Lytton refinery in Queensland, a network of petrol stations, and acquiring EG Australia's retail sites in 2025. Listed on the ASX (ALD). Revenue is about 30 billion Australian dollars. Strong consumer brand in Australia and a long-standing sponsor of motorsport and sports.

wiki.title: Ampol
wiki.text: Ampol Limited is an Australian petroleum company headquartered in Alexandria, New South Wales, a suburb of Sydney. Ampol is the largest transport energy distributor and retailer in Australia, with more than 1,800 Ampol-branded service stations across the country as of June 2025. Ampol also operates in New Zealand through its subsidiary Z Energy.

about: EDP (Energias de Portugal) is a Portuguese integrated energy company and one of the world's largest renewables operators through EDP Renovaveis (EDPR), with hydro, wind, solar and grid businesses in Portugal, Spain, Brazil and the US. It serves millions of electricity and gas customers and has around 13,000 employees, with revenue near 16 billion euros. Headquartered in Lisbon and listed on Euronext Lisbon (EDP). China Three Gorges is its largest shareholder. Recognised consumer utility brand in Iberia, a sponsor of Portuguese and European sport.

wiki.title: EDP Group
wiki.text: EDP is a Portuguese electric utilities company, headquartered in Lisbon founded in 1976 through the merger of 14 nationalised electricity companies.

about: Statkraft is Norway's state-owned energy company and Europe's largest generator of renewable energy, with hydropower as its core plus wind, solar, gas and district heating, and energy trading. It operates in about 20 countries including Norway, Sweden, Germany, the UK, Spain, Brazil, Chile, India and Turkey, with around 7,000 employees. Headquartered in Oslo and 100% owned by the Norwegian state. Customers are grids, industry and traders. B2B with modest consumer awareness outside Norway.

wiki.title: Statkraft
wiki.text: Statkraft AS is a hydropower company, fully owned by the Norwegian state. The Statkraft Group is Europe's largest generator of renewable energy, as well as Norway's largest and the Nordic region's third largest energy producer. Statkraft develops and generates hydropower, wind power, gas power, district heating and solar power. It is also a player in the international energy markets. The company has 7,000 employees in over 20 countries with their headquarters located in Oslo, Norway.

about: Metso is a Finnish industrial company supplying equipment, services and technology for mining, aggregates, recycling and metal refining, including crushers, mills, pumps and screens. Customers are mining and construction companies worldwide, with sales of around EUR 4.5 billion and roughly 17,000 employees. It was formed in 2020 when Metso Minerals combined with Outotec. Headquartered in Espoo and listed on Nasdaq Helsinki (METSO). B2B with a low consumer profile.

wiki.title: Metso
wiki.text: Metso Corporation was a Finnish industrial machinery company focusing on providing technology and services for mining, and aggregates industries.

about: Suncor Energy is a Canadian integrated energy company, headquartered in Calgary, with oil sands mining, upgrading and in-situ operations, refineries and the Petro-Canada retail network of about 1,500 sites. Customers include consumers at the pump and industrial buyers, with revenue of more than C$50 billion. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (SU). Petro-Canada is a leading Canadian consumer brand and a prolific sports sponsor, including Olympic partnership.

wiki.title: Suncor Energy
wiki.text: Suncor Energy Inc. is a Canadian integrated energy company based in Calgary, Alberta. It specializes in production of synthetic crude from oil sands. In the 2026 Forbes Global 2000, Suncor Energy was ranked as the 256th-largest public company in the world.

about: SkyNRG is an Amsterdam company that produces and supplies sustainable aviation fuel to airlines such as KLM, working with partners in the Netherlands and the US, including a plant at Delfzijl. It was founded in 2009. Customers are airlines and corporates. B2B with strong credentials in sustainable aviation, relevant to sustainability partnerships. Customers are airlines and corporate travellers who buy sustainable fuel. It is a B2B brand with strong standing among aviation sustainability stakeholders.

wiki.title: SkyNRG
wiki.text: SkyNRG B.V. is a Dutch company headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, that sources and supplies sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) for use on commercial flights.

about: Greece's largest energy group, formerly Hellenic Petroleum, which refines crude oil at Aspropyrgos, Elefsina and Thessaloniki and sells fuels through retail brands EKO and Hellenic Fuels (BP in Greece). Also expanding into renewables, power and gas. Listed on the Athens exchange (ELPE); main shareholders are the Latsis family's Paneuropean Oil and Industrial Holdings and the Greek state. Operations in Greece, Cyprus and the Balkans, with revenue of roughly EUR 10 billion a year. EKO is a well-known consumer fuel brand in Greece.

French fuel and energy group based in Puteaux that distributes fuels, LPG and bitumen and operates storage terminals, mainly in the Caribbean, Africa and Europe. Listed on Euronext Paris (RUI). Also runs renewable electricity activity through its Photosol business. Revenue about EUR 6 billion a year. Funding of about $265 million shown. Retail fuel stations under its brand give it consumer visibility in its markets, though it is little known in mainstream French sport or media.

wiki.title: Rubis (company)
wiki.text: Rubis SCA is a France-based international company specialized in the storage, distribution and sale of petroleum, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), food and chemical products. Rubis is market leader in France, Switzerland, Bermuda, Jamaica, Madagascar, Morocco, French Antilles-Guiana, Senegal the Channel Islands and Kenya. The company's business are carried on by a number of subsidiaries, including Coparef, Rubis Terminal, Vitogaz, Kelsey Gas Ltd, Lasfargaz, La Collette Terminal, among others.

about: SK On is a South Korean electric vehicle battery maker headquartered in Seoul, a subsidiary of SK Innovation spun off in 2021. It supplies lithium-ion pouch cells and modules to Hyundai, Kia, Ford (via BlueOval SK joint venture), Volkswagen and Mercedes-Benz, with plants in Korea, the US, Hungary and China. A top global battery maker by market share, with debt and equity funding of over $7 billion. B2B supplier, little consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: SK On
wiki.text: SK On (Korean: SK온) is a battery company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Spun off in 2021, it is a subsidiary of SK Innovation, a member of SK Group. Its batteries are used for electric vehicles and ESS. SK Trading International, SK Enterm, and SK Enmove were merged into SK On from 2024 to 2025.

about: ACWA Power is a Riyadh-based Saudi developer, investor, co-owner and operator of power generation and desalinated water plants, with projects in Saudi Arabia, the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia and China, including large solar, wind and green hydrogen projects such as NEOM. Majority owned by the Public Investment Fund with about 44 percent, and listed on the Saudi exchange (2082). B2B utility developer, with limited consumer awareness; a notable sports sponsor.

wiki.title: ACWA Power
wiki.what: Saudi power generation and desalinated water production organization
wiki.text: Acwa is a developer, investor, co-owner and operator of a portfolio of power generation and desalinated water production plants with a presence in 14 countries across the Middle East, Africa, and Central and Southeast Asia. Acwa's portfolio of projects in operation and development has an investment value of USD 107.5 billion, and a capacity of 78.85 GW of power and produces 9.5 million m3 /day of desalinated water.

about: Contemporary Amperex Technology (CATL) is a Ningde, Fujian-based Chinese battery maker, founded in 2011, and the world's largest EV and energy storage battery manufacturer with about a third of the global market. It supplies Tesla, BMW, Volkswagen, Mercedes, Stellantis and Chinese automakers with lithium iron phosphate and nickel-based cells. Listed in Shenzhen (300750) and Hong Kong (3750). B2B supplier with growing brand visibility, including sponsorship of UEFA football.

wiki.title: CATL
wiki.text: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited, (CATL) is a Chinese battery manufacturer and technology company founded in 2011 that specializes in the manufacturing of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems, as well as battery management systems (BMS). CATL is the biggest EV and energy storage battery manufacturer in the world, with a global market share of around 37% and 36.8% in 2022 and 2023, respectively. It is headquartered in Ningde, Fujian province, where it maintains its flagship manufacturing hub.

about: Electricite de France (EDF) is a Paris-based French state-owned electric utility, the world's largest nuclear power operator, generating and selling electricity and gas in France, the UK, Italy and elsewhere, with about 37 million customers and 170,000 employees. Fully nationalised by the French state in 2023. Revenue is above 100 billion euros. Very high consumer brand awareness in France, and a long-time Olympic and sports sponsor.

wiki.title: Électricité de France
wiki.text: Électricité de France, commonly known as EDF, is a French multinational electric utility company owned by the government of France. Headquartered in Paris, with €139.7 billion in sales in 2023, EDF operates a diverse portfolio of at least 120 gigawatts of generation capacity in Europe, South America, North America, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. In 2009, EDF was the world's largest producer of electricity. Its 56 active nuclear reactors in France are spread out over 18 sites. They comprise 32 reactors of 900 MWe, 20 reactors of 1,300 MWe, and 4 reactors of 1,450 MWe, all PWRs.

about: Enel is a Rome-based Italian multinational energy company, the largest private renewable power operator in the world, generating, distributing and selling electricity and gas in Italy, Spain, Latin America and elsewhere, with about 60 million customers. Listed on Borsa Italiana (ENEL), with the Italian government holding about 24 percent. Revenue is about 90 billion euros. Strong consumer brand in Italy, and a partner in sports including Formula E and MotoGP in the past.

wiki.title: Enel
wiki.what: Multinational energy company based in Italy
wiki.text: Enel S.p.A. is an Italian multinational producer and distributor of electricity and gas. Enel was established as a public body at the end of 1962 and was transformed into a limited company in 1992. In 1999, following the liberalisation of the electricity market in Italy, Enel was privatised. The Italian state, through the Ministry of Economy and Finance, is the company's largest shareholder, holding 23.6% of its share capital as of 31 December 2024.

about: Iberdrola is a Bilbao-based Spanish electric utility and one of the world's largest renewable energy producers, with wind, solar, hydro, networks and retail in Spain, the UK (ScottishPower), the US (Avangrid) and Brazil. It serves about 40 million customers, with revenue near 45 billion euros. Listed on the Spanish exchange (IBE). Strong consumer brand in Spain and the UK, with a record of sports sponsorship including women's football and rugby.

wiki.title: Iberdrola
wiki.text: Iberdrola, S.A. is a Spanish multinational electric utility company based in Bilbao, Spain. It has around 40,000 employees and serves around 30 million customers.

about: Mercuria is a Geneva, Switzerland-based commodity trading company, founded in 2004 by Marco Dunand and Daniel Jaeggi, trading crude oil, refined products, natural gas, power, metals and agricultural commodities, and investing in energy storage and renewables. One of the world's top independent trading houses with revenue above $100 billion. Privately owned by its management. B2B with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Mercuria
wiki.text: Mercuria Energy Group Ltd. is a Cayman Islands-domiciled Swiss multinational commodity trading company active in a wide spectrum of global energy markets including crude oil and refined petroleum products, natural gas, power, biodiesel, base metals and agricultural products. The company is one of the world's five largest independent energy traders and asset operators and is based in Geneva, Switzerland, with 37 additional offices worldwide. The group operates in 50 countries.

about: Sysco is a Houston-based US foodservice distributor (NYSE: SYY), the largest in the world, delivering food, kitchen supplies and equipment to restaurants, hospitals, hotels and schools in the US, Canada and Europe, with revenue of about $80 billion and 330 distribution centers. Customers are foodservice operators, not consumers. B2B, with a recognisable truck brand but limited consumer awareness; a sponsor of golf and baseball in the US.

wiki.title: Sysco
wiki.text: Sysco is an American multinational corporation that sells, markets, and distributes food products to restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, sports stadiums, and other venues that serve food. It also sells foodservice supplies and equipment. The company is headquartered in the Energy Corridor district of Houston, Texas.

about: Trafigura is a Singapore and Geneva-based commodity trader, founded in 1993, trading crude oil, refined products, metals, minerals, gas, power and agricultural goods, and owning Puma Energy (retail fuel in 50 countries) and Impala Terminals. Revenue is more than $200 billion. Privately owned by employees. Customers are producers, refiners and industrials. B2B, but Puma Energy forecourts give some consumer visibility, and it has sponsored sports and arts.

wiki.title: Trafigura
wiki.text: Trafigura Group Pte. Ltd. is a Singaporean‑based multinational commodities company, founded in 1993, with major regional hubs in Geneva, Houston, Montevideo, and Mumbai. The company trades in base metals and energy. It is the world's largest private metal trader and the second‑largest oil trader, having built or purchased stakes in pipelines, mines, smelters, ports, and storage terminals.

about: AES is an Arlington, Virginia-based global power company (NYSE: AES) that generates and distributes electricity, including renewables and storage, through utilities in the US (AES Indiana, AES Ohio) and operations in Chile, Brazil, Mexico, Panama and the Dominican Republic. Customers are utilities, industrials and households. Revenue is around $12 billion. Largely B2B with local consumer exposure, and moderate brand awareness.

COX Group is a Spanish company headquartered in Seville that develops water, energy and infrastructure projects, including desalination, solar power plants and green hydrogen across Europe, Africa, the Middle East and Latin America. Its business lines cover engineering, construction and operation of concessions, and it has raised large project financing. Privately held. B2B infrastructure developer with limited consumer brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: COX Group provides solutions for development and...

about: EnBW (Energie Baden-Wurttemberg) is one of Germany's largest energy companies, headquartered in Karlsruhe and about 98 percent owned by the state of Baden-Wurttemberg and municipal associations. It generates, trades and distributes electricity, gas and water, operates grids, offshore wind farms and EV charging networks (EnBW mobility+), and serves millions of customers with about 27,000 employees and revenue over 40 billion euros. Founded 1997. Well-known German utility brand; local sports sponsor, including football.

wiki.title: EnBW
wiki.what: Publicly-traded energy company headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany
wiki.text: EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG, or simply EnBW, is a publicly traded energy company headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany. It is the third-largest energy company in Germany, serving approximately 5.5 million customers.

about: Enfinity Global is a renewable energy developer and independent power producer with roots in Belgium and Italy, now headquartered in Miami, developing solar and storage projects across Europe, the Americas, Africa and Asia-Pacific, and with a global project pipeline of several gigawatts. Backed by private equity and lenders, it sells power under long-term contracts to utilities and corporates. Founded in 2007. B2B energy developer with little public brand awareness.
cb_desc: Enfinity Global is a renewable energy company that focuses...

about: Engie is a French multinational energy and services group headquartered in Paris (La Defense), listed on Euronext Paris (ENGI), with the French state as its largest shareholder. It generates and sells electricity, natural gas and renewable energy, operates networks and offers energy efficiency and building services, with about 97,000 employees and revenue around 70 billion euros, across Europe, Latin America, the Middle East and the US. Formed by the 2008 merger of Gaz de France and Suez. Strong consumer brand in France and Belgium and a sponsor of sport and events.

wiki.title: Engie
wiki.text: Engie SA is a French multinational electric utility company, headquartered in La Défense, Courbevoie. Its activities cover electricity generation and distribution, natural gas, nuclear power, renewable energy, district energy, and the petroleum industry. It is involved in both upstream and downstream activities.

about: Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company) is a state-owned renewable energy company headquartered in Abu Dhabi, owned by TAQA, Mubadala and ADNOC. It develops and operates solar, wind and green hydrogen projects in over 40 countries, targeting 100 GW of capacity by 2030, and runs Masdar City, a sustainability-focused urban development. Customers are utilities and governments. Founded 2006 and a host of the COP28 climate talks in Dubai in 2023. B2B with strong government and sustainability brand profile.

wiki.title: Masdar
wiki.text: Masdar, also known as the Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company, is a United Arab Emirates state-owned renewable energy company. It was founded in 2006 as a subsidiary of the UAE state-owned Mubadala Investment Company. Masdar has worked to deflect criticisms of the UAE, a major fossil fuel producer, and defend the country's environmental record.

about: Matrix Renewables is a renewable energy platform headquartered in Madrid, owned by institutional investors, developing solar and storage projects in the US, Spain, Chile, Mexico, Colombia and Peru. It sells power to utilities under long-term contracts and has secured large project financing. B2B energy developer with limited consumer brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: Matrix Renewables is a renewable energy platform fo...

about: NextEra Energy is a major US energy company based in Juno Beach/Palm Beach, Florida and listed on the NYSE (NEE). Its regulated utility Florida Power & Light serves around 6 million customer accounts, while NextEra Energy Resources is the world's largest generator of wind and solar power, with large battery storage and nuclear operations. Revenue is roughly 25 billion dollars. Customers are households, utilities and corporate buyers. Founded in 1925. Strong utility brand in Florida; sponsors sports and community events there.

wiki.title: NextEra Energy
wiki.text: NextEra Energy, Inc. is an American energy company that is the world's largest electric utility holding company by market capitalization, with a valuation of over $187 billion as of July 2026. NextEra Energy had revenues of $24.8 billion and 16,700 employees throughout the US and Canada in 2024. It has a current generating capacity of 73 gigawatts. Its subsidiaries include Florida Power & Light (FPL), NextEra Energy Resources (NEER), XPLR Energy Partners, and NextEra Energy Services.

about: RWE is a German energy company headquartered in Essen, listed on the Frankfurt exchange (RWE) and a DAX member. It generates power from offshore and onshore wind, solar, hydro, gas and battery storage, is one of the world's largest offshore wind operators, and trades energy; the coal and nuclear exit is under way. Employs about 20,000 people, with revenue around 25 billion euros. Founded 1898. Customers are utilities and industry; consumer retail now largely handled elsewhere. Well-known German brand with football sponsorship history, including Bundesliga links.

wiki.title: RWE
wiki.text: RWE AG is a German multinational energy company headquartered in Essen. It generates and trades electricity in the Asia-Pacific region, Europe and the United States.

about: AESC (Envision AESC) is a Japanese-headquartered lithium-ion battery maker based in Yokohama, founded in 2007 as a Nissan and NEC joint venture and since 2018 owned by China's Envision Group. It produces cells and packs for electric vehicles, including the Nissan Leaf, at plants in Japan, the UK (Sunderland), the US (Tennessee, South Carolina) and China, with plans for more in France and Spain. Customers are automakers such as Nissan and Renault. B2B supplier with limited consumer awareness.

Darling Ingredients is a global converter of food waste and animal by-products into ingredients: fats, proteins, collagen and gelatin (Rousselot, Gelnex), pet food ingredients, and renewable fuels such as renewable diesel through the Diamond Green Diesel joint venture with Valero. Customers are food, feed, pharma, pet food and fuel markets. Headquartered in Irving, Texas, with over 260 plants on five continents and revenue around $6 billion. Listed on NYSE (DAR). B2B, little consumer awareness.

Octopus Energy is a UK energy retailer supplying electricity and gas to millions of households, known for smart tariffs, heat pumps and EV charging, and it also licenses the Kraken utility software platform to other energy suppliers worldwide. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, with operations in Europe, the US, Australia, Japan and elsewhere. Part of Octopus Group, with Kraken spun out as a separately funded business. Private. Strong consumer brand in the UK.

wiki.title: Octopus Energy
wiki.what: Energy supplier in the United Kingdom
wiki.text: Octopus Energy Group Limited, known as Octopus Energy, is a British company operating in the fields of energy generation and supply.

about: Valero Energy is the world's largest independent petroleum refiner, with about 15 refineries making gasoline, diesel and jet fuel, plus renewable diesel through Diamond Green Diesel and ethanol plants. Sells fuel to wholesale customers and through branded retail stations, including Valero, Beacon and Shamrock, with revenue over $100 billion. Headquartered in San Antonio, Texas. Listed on NYSE (VLO). Recognised consumer fuel brand in the US, and a longtime motorsport and sports sponsor, including NASCAR and the Valero Texas Open.

wiki.title: Valero Energy
wiki.text: Valero Energy Corporation is an American-based fuels producer mostly involved in manufacturing and marketing transportation fuels and other related products. It is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, United States. Throughout the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, the company owns and operates 14 refineries with a combined throughput capacity of approximately 3.2 million barrels per day, two renewable diesel plants that produce approximately 1.2 billion gallons per year, and 12 ethanol plants with a combined production capacity of 1.6 billion gallons as its subsidiaries.

about: LG Energy Solution is a South Korean maker of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, energy storage systems and IT devices, supplying GM, Hyundai, Stellantis, Honda and other carmakers from plants in Korea, the US, Poland, China and Indonesia. Spun out of LG Chem in 2020 and listed on the Korea Exchange (373220) in January 2022, in one of the largest Korean IPOs. Headquartered in Seoul, with annual revenue of about 25 trillion won. B2B supplier, known through the LG brand.

wiki.title: LG Energy Solution
wiki.text: LG Energy Solution Ltd. is a battery company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. LGES is one of the largest battery makers in the world, with its product applications including electric vehicles and ESS.

about: AMEA Power is a Dubai-based renewable energy developer and independent power producer building solar, wind and battery storage projects in Africa and the Middle East, including in Egypt, Morocco, Jordan, Zambia and South Africa. It sells electricity to national utilities and industrial customers under long-term contracts. Founded in 2016 by Hussain Al Nowais. Crunchbase shows about $2.1 billion in funding, including project debt. Privately held. B2B brand, no consumer awareness.
cb_desc: AMEA Power is a renewable energy company that develop...

wiki.title: AMEA Power
wiki.text: AMEA Power is a developer, investor, owner, and operator of renewable energy projects in the Middle East, Asia and Africa. It is based in Dubai, UAE, and is a subsidiary of Al Nowais Investments.

about: Brookfield Renewable Partners is one of the world's largest publicly traded renewable power platforms, owning hydro, wind, solar and storage assets across North America, South America, Europe and Asia, and selling power to utilities and corporate buyers under long-term contracts. Part of Brookfield Asset Management, with offices in Toronto. Listed on NYSE (BEP) and TSX (BEP.UN). B2B energy brand, known in infrastructure investing with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Brookfield Renewable Partners
wiki.what: Publicly traded limited partnership that owns and operates renewable power assets
wiki.text: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. is a publicly traded limited partnership that owns and operates renewable power assets, with corporate headquarters in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It is approximately 45% owned by Brookfield Asset Management.

about: GE Vernova is a global energy equipment company spun out of General Electric in April 2024, making gas turbines, wind turbines, grid equipment and electrification software, and servicing power plants. Customers are utilities, governments and industrial buyers, with revenue of about $35 billion. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts (listed in Crunchbase as Boston). Listed on NYSE (GEV). B2B brand, known in energy and industry, with moderate consumer awareness through the GE heritage.

wiki.title: GE Vernova
wiki.text: GE Vernova, Inc. is an energy equipment manufacturing and services company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The company operates through three main segments: Power, which designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies; Wind, which provides onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades; and Electrification, which offers grid solutions, power conversion, solar and storage solutions, and digital technologies for the transmission, distribution, and management of electricity.

about: Sao Paulo-based Brazilian joint venture of Cosan and Shell, founded 2011, producing sugar and ethanol from cane and distributing fuels under the Shell licence at over 8,000 service stations in Brazil. Revenue exceeds BRL 200 billion. Listed on B3 (RAIZ4). Strong consumer exposure in Brazil via Shell-branded stations; otherwise energy and agribusiness. Raizen employs about 40,000 people, runs dozens of mills and is among Brazil's largest companies by revenue.

wiki.title: Raízen
wiki.text: Raízen S.A. is the third largest Brazilian energy company by revenue and the fifth largest in Brazil. The company is a joint-venture formed in 2010 from the merger of the assets of sugar, fuel and ethanol derived from Cosan and Royal Dutch Shell in Brazil. The company has a market value of approximately US$0.8Billion in Set-24. Its revenue of about US$45.5 billion in the 2023/2024 harvest year.

about: Houston-headquartered oilfield services company, formerly Schlumberger and renamed SLB in 2022, providing reservoir characterisation, drilling, well completion, production and digital technology to energy producers in more than 100 countries. Revenue about $35 billion, with roughly 100,000 employees. Founded 1926; listed on the NYSE (SLB). B2B brand with no consumer awareness. It also sells digital platforms, carbon capture and data centre infrastructure, and has a globally recognised name in oil and gas.

wiki.title: SLB
wiki.text: SLB, formerly known as Schlumberger, is a multinational oilfield services company. Founded in France in 1926, the company is now incorporated as SLB N.V. in Willemstad, Curaçao, with principal executive offices in four cities: Paris, France; Houston, Texas, United States; London, UK; and The Hague, Netherlands. As of 2022, it is both the world's largest offshore drilling company and the world's largest offshore drilling contractor by revenue.

about: Zelestra is a Spanish renewable energy developer, formerly Solarpack, headquartered in the Basque Country and owned by EQT. It develops, builds and operates solar, wind and storage projects in Europe, the US and Latin America, and sells electricity to utilities and corporate offtakers. Funding shown is about $2.1 billion. B2B with no consumer visibility. Zelestra has projects in Spain, Italy, Poland, Romania and the US, and has a pipeline of many gigawatts.
cb_desc: Zelestra is a renewable energy company dedlicated to serving...

about: Orsted is a Danish renewable energy company and the world's largest developer of offshore wind farms, headquartered in Fredericia (earlier Gentofte) and formerly the oil and gas firm DONG Energy. It builds and operates offshore and onshore wind, solar and storage, supplying power to utilities, corporates and governments in Europe, North America and Asia. Listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (ORSTED), with the Danish state as majority owner, and revenue around 70 billion Danish kroner. Mostly B2B, recognised in Denmark and the UK, with project setbacks in the US since 2023.

wiki.title: Ørsted (company)
wiki.text: Ørsted A/S is a majority state-owned Danish multinational energy company. Headquartered in Fredericia, Denmark, Ørsted is the largest energy company in Denmark. The company adopted its current name on 6 November 2017. It was previously known as DONG Energy.

about: GreenYellow is a French renewable energy company headquartered in Puteaux, founded in 2007 within the Casino retail group's orbit and now independent of it. It designs, installs and operates solar power plants and energy efficiency services for retailers, industrial and commercial clients in France, Brazil, Colombia, Asia and Africa. Revenue comes from power sales and services. B2B with limited public awareness.
cb_desc: GreenYellow provides sustainable energy solutions f..

about: nVent is an electrical connection and protection company, legally Irish and operationally run from London and Minneapolis, spun off from Pentair in 2018 and listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NVT). It makes enclosures, data centre cooling, cable heat-tracing and fastening products under brands like Hoffman, Erico and Raychem. Customers are industrial, utility and data centre firms, with revenue of about $3 billion. B2B with low consumer awareness.

Poste Italiane is Italy's state-controlled postal and financial services group, headquartered in Rome, listed on Borsa Italiana (PST). It delivers mail and parcels, operates PostePay payments, savings and insurance products, and sells mobile and energy services, with about 12,800 post offices and tens of millions of customers. The Italian Ministry of Economy and CDP hold the majority. It has sponsored sport and is a household name in Italy.

wiki.title: Poste Italiane
wiki.text: Poste Italiane is the Italian postal service provider. Besides providing postal services, Poste Italiane offers communications, postal savings products, logistics, and financial and insurance services throughout Italy.

about: Technip Energies is a Paris-based engineering and technology company, spun off from TechnipFMC in 2021 and listed on Euronext Paris (TE), which designs and builds LNG plants, hydrogen, ethylene and decarbonisation facilities, working for energy producers. Revenue is about 7 billion euros and it has thousands of engineers. B2B, with high standing among oil, gas and energy transition clients but no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Technip Energies
wiki.text: Technip Energies NV is a French engineering and technology company for the energy industry and chemicals sector.

about: Westinghouse Electric Company is a Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania nuclear technology company that designs reactors (AP1000 and AP300), supplies fuel and provides services and maintenance to nuclear plants worldwide. It is owned by Brookfield Renewable and Cameco, after emerging from bankruptcy in 2018, and was part of a 2025 US government agreement to build new reactors. Customers are utilities and governments. B2B, with high profile in the energy sector.

wiki.title: Westinghouse Electric Company
wiki.text: Westinghouse Electric Company LLC is an American nuclear power company formed in 1999 from the nuclear power division of the original Westinghouse Electric Corporation. It offers nuclear products and services to utilities internationally, including nuclear fuel, service and maintenance, instrumentation, control and design of nuclear power plants. Westinghouse's world headquarters are located in the Pittsburgh suburb of Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania.

about: Baker Hughes is a Houston-based energy technology company providing oilfield services and equipment, turbines, compressors, LNG technology and industrial and climate solutions to oil and gas, power and industrial customers in over 120 countries, with about 55,000 employees. Revenue is around $27 billion. It resulted from the 2017 combination of Baker Hughes and GE Oil & Gas, and is listed on Nasdaq (BKR). B2B brand, but it has previously sponsored motorsport and sports.

wiki.title: Baker Hughes
wiki.text: Baker Hughes Company is an American global energy technology company co-headquartered in Houston, Texas and London, UK. As one of the world's largest oil field services, industrial and energy technology companies, it provides products and services to the oil and gas industry for exploration and production, as well as other energy and industrial applications. It operates in over 120 countries, with facilities in Australia, Brazil, Singapore, Malaysia, India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Italy, Germany, Norway, the United Kingdom, Namibia, Nigeria and the United States.

about: Carrier Global is a Palm Beach Gardens, Florida maker of heating, ventilation, air conditioning, refrigeration and fire and security systems, with brands including Carrier, Toshiba and Viessmann Climate Solutions, selling to homeowners, buildings and cold-chain customers worldwide with roughly 45,000 employees. Spun out of United Technologies in 2020 and listed on the NYSE (CARR). Revenue around $22 billion. Carrier brand is widely known, though sales run through dealers and contractors.

wiki.title: Carrier Global
wiki.text: Carrier Global Corporation is an American multinational heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, and fire and security equipment corporation based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. Carrier was founded in 1915 as an independent company manufacturing and distributing HVAC systems, and has since expanded to include manufacturing commercial refrigeration and food service equipment, and fire and security technologies.

about: Sinopec Group (China Petrochemical Corporation) is a Beijing-based Chinese state-owned energy and chemicals giant, one of the world's largest companies by revenue, with oil and gas exploration, refining, petrochemicals and about 30,000 Sinopec petrol stations in China. Its listed unit, China Petroleum & Chemical (SNP), trades in Hong Kong (0386) and Shanghai (600028). Strongly recognised consumer fuel brand in China, with a history of sponsorship, including motorsport and Olympic activity.

wiki.title: Sinopec
wiki.text: China Petroleum and Chemical Corporation, or Sinopec Group, is a Chinese oil and gas enterprise based in Chaoyang District, Beijing. The SASAC administers the group for the benefit of the State Council of China. Sinopec Group operates a publicly traded subsidiary, also called Sinopec, listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai stock exchanges. Sinopec Group is the world's largest oil refining conglomerate, state owned enterprise, and 6th highest revenue company in the world.

about: Sunwoda Electronic is a Shenzhen based Chinese lithium-ion battery maker, with consumer electronics battery packs, EV batteries and energy storage, supplying customers including Apple and other phone makers, and carmakers such as BMW and Nissan-related projects. Founded in 1997, it is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (300207) and also has EVB (EVE-type) battery businesses. It operates factories in China and overseas. It is a B2B supplier with low consumer brand recognition outside Asia.

TotalEnergies is a Paris based integrated energy company producing oil and gas, running refineries and petrochemicals, retailing fuel through over 10,000 service stations, and growing in LNG, renewables and electricity. It employs around 100,000 people and works in more than 120 countries, with annual revenue near 200 billion dollars. It is listed on Euronext Paris (TTE) and the NYSE. It is a very recognizable consumer brand, long a Formula 1 sponsor linked to Alpine, Ferrari and others, and sponsors cycling and motorsport.

wiki.title: TotalEnergies
wiki.what: French multinational energy and petroleum company
wiki.text: TotalEnergies SE is a French multinational integrated energy and petroleum company founded in 1924 and is one of the seven supermajor oil companies. Its businesses cover the entire oil and gas chain, from crude oil and natural gas exploration and production to power generation, transportation, refining, petroleum product marketing, and international crude oil and product trading. TotalEnergies is also a large-scale chemicals manufacturer.

about: Clarios is a global maker of automotive batteries, headquartered in Glendale, Wisconsin (Milwaukee area), spun out of Johnson Controls in 2019 and owned by Brookfield Business Partners. It supplies roughly one in three of the world's cars with 12-volt and start-stop batteries, and sells the brands Varta, Optima, LTH and Interstate under OEM supply deals. It operates dozens of plants worldwide and has revenue near 9 billion dollars. Brands like Varta and Optima are visible to aftermarket consumers.

Contemporary Amperex Technology (CATL), listed here under a variant of its name, is the world's largest electric vehicle battery maker, based in Ningde, Fujian, supplying Tesla, BMW, Mercedes, Volkswagen, NIO and others, and selling energy storage systems. Founded in 2011, it is listed in Shenzhen (300750) and Hong Kong (3750), with revenue above 40 billion dollars. B2B but increasingly visible through its motorsport and sport partnerships.

wiki.title: CATL
wiki.text: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited, (CATL) is a Chinese battery manufacturer and technology company founded in 2011 that specializes in the manufacturing of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems, as well as battery management systems (BMS). CATL is the biggest EV and energy storage battery manufacturer in the world, with a global market share of around 37% and 36.8% in 2022 and 2023, respectively. It is headquartered in Ningde, Fujian province, where it maintains its flagship manufacturing hub.

about: First Solar is a US maker of thin-film cadmium telluride solar modules, one of the largest solar manufacturers outside China, with factories in the US, India, Vietnam and Malaysia. Customers are utility-scale solar developers and power producers, paid under multi-year supply contracts. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, and listed on Nasdaq (FSLR), with a market value of tens of billions of dollars. B2B with modest consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: First Solar
wiki.text: First Solar, Inc. is an American publicly traded manufacturer of solar panels. First Solar uses rigid thin-film modules for its solar panels, and produces CdTe panels using cadmium telluride (CdTe) as a semiconductor. The predecessor company, Solar Cells, Inc., was founded in 1990 by inventor Harold McMaster. In 1999, Solar Cells, Inc., was purchased by True North Partners, LLC, led by Michael Ahearn, and rebranded as First Solar, Inc.

about: Qcells is the US arm of Hanwha Qcells, a South Korean solar manufacturer, developing and building solar modules, storage and projects, including a large panel factory in Georgia, and a residential solar sales and installation arm. It is a Hanwha Solutions unit; Hanwha Solutions is listed in Seoul. US operations are headquartered in Irvine, California. Customers are installers, utilities and homeowners. Strong brand in solar, with some sports sponsorships.

wiki.title: Qcells
wiki.text: Qcells is a manufacturer of photovoltaic cells. The company is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, after being founded in 1999 in Bitterfeld-Wolfen, Germany, where the company still has its engineering offices. Qcells was purchased out of bankruptcy in August 2012 by the Hanwha Group, a South Korean business conglomerate. Qcells now operates as a subsidiary of Hanwha Solutions, the group's energy and petrochemical company.

about: APR Energy is a US-based provider of fast-track mobile gas turbine power plants, supplying temporary and bridging electricity to utilities, governments and industry in countries such as Iraq, Argentina, Libya and the Americas. Based in Jacksonville, Florida. It is privately held. Revenue is rental and fuel. B2B with no consumer profile.

Avnet is a US technology distributor, based in Phoenix, Arizona, that supplies electronic components, embedded solutions and IT services to equipment makers worldwide, with revenue of about $22 billion. Founded in 1921, its customers are manufacturers and OEMs. Listed on Nasdaq (AVT). B2B with no consumer brand, although it has had some motorsport partnerships.

wiki.title: Avnet
wiki.text: Avnet, Inc. is a distributor of electronic components headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, named after Charles Avnet, who founded the company in 1921. After its start on Manhattan's Radio Row, the company was incorporated in 1955 and began trading on the New York Stock Exchange in 1961. On May 8, 2018, Avnet changed stock markets to Nasdaq, trading under the same ticker AVT.

about: Repsol is a Spanish integrated energy company, based in Madrid, active in oil and gas exploration and production, refining, chemicals, low-carbon fuels and renewable power, and a network of about 4,500 service stations in Spain, Portugal, Mexico and Peru. Employs about 25,000 people, with revenue of tens of billions of euros. Listed on the Madrid exchange (REP). A long-standing motorsport sponsor, especially in MotoGP and rallying, with high consumer visibility in Spain.

wiki.title: Repsol
wiki.what: Spanish multinational energy and petrochemical company
wiki.text: Repsol S.A. is a Spanish multinational energy and petrochemical company based in Madrid. It is engaged in worldwide upstream and downstream activities. In the 2022 Forbes Global 2000, Repsol was ranked as the 320th-largest public company in the world. As of 2022, it has 24,000 employees worldwide.

about: Gotion High-tech is a Hefei, China battery maker that develops and produces lithium iron phosphate batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage, with Volkswagen Group as its largest shareholder since 2020. Listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, it has plants in China and overseas, including Germany, Slovakia and Morocco, and a cancelled Michigan project. Customers are carmakers and energy storage buyers. B2B supplier with little consumer awareness.

Sociedad Quimica y Minera (SQM) is a Santiago, Chile miner and chemical producer, one of the world's largest lithium producers from Atacama salt flats, also making iodine, potassium nitrate and specialty plant nutrients. Customers are battery makers, farms and industrial firms. It is listed on NYSE and Santiago (SQM). A 2025 joint venture with Codelco advances its lithium business. B2B with little consumer brand.

Trina Solar is a Changzhou, Jiangsu manufacturer of photovoltaic modules, trackers and energy storage products, and one of the world's largest solar panel makers, with global shipments of tens of gigawatts. Founded in 1997 and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market (688599). Customers are utilities, developers and installers. B2B, but known as an industry brand and a sponsor of events worldwide.

wiki.title: Trina Solar
wiki.text: Trina Solar Co., Ltd., stylized as Trinasolar, is a Chinese photovoltaics company founded in 1997.

about: Power Corporation of Canada is a Montreal-based diversified holding company with controlling stakes in Canadian financial groups Great-West Lifeco, IGM Financial and also in Wealthsimple, and Sagard private equity. It manages about 1 trillion dollars across its businesses. Listed on the TSX (POW). Controlled by the Desmarais family. Its subsidiaries are well-known to Canadian consumers. Its units operate in Canada, the US and Europe. The group has a strong standing in Canadian business, and is a B2B investor without a consumer brand.

wiki.title: Power Corporation of Canada
wiki.text: Power Corporation of Canada (PCC) is a Canadian company founded in 1925. Initially focused on the electric utility and similar industries, it has since become a holding company with an emphasis on financial services across North America, Europe and Asia. PCC holdings include businesses in insurance, retirement services, wealth management, investment management and alternative investments.

about: Chinese state-owned power equipment maker based in Shanghai, listed in Shanghai (601727) and Hong Kong (2727), making thermal, wind, nuclear and grid equipment and industrial services. One of China's largest equipment groups. It owns a minority stake in the Italian power equipment maker Ansaldo Energia. B2B manufacturer with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Shanghai Electric
wiki.what: Chinese multinational power generation and electrical equipment manufacturing company
wiki.text: Shanghai Electric is a Chinese multinational power generation and electrical equipment manufacturing company headquartered in Shanghai. The company traces its roots to 1880.

about: Sensata Technologies is a global industrial technology company that designs and manufactures sensors, switches, controls and electrical protection components. It is based in Attleboro, Massachusetts, though legally incorporated in the UK, and its products go into cars, trucks, aircraft, HVAC equipment, industrial machinery and electric vehicles, including tyre pressure monitoring and battery contactors. Revenue is around $3.5 billion with roughly 19,000 employees, and it is listed on the NYSE (ST). B2B, supplying automotive makers, with little consumer brand awareness; an automotive supplier angle is relevant to F1.

Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader in electrification, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland (formerly ABB Power Grids, acquired by Hitachi in stages from 2020). It makes transformers, high-voltage direct current systems, grid automation and software for utilities, industry and renewable energy developers, with some 50,000 employees. Wholly owned by Hitachi Ltd of Japan. B2B with moderate public awareness and an existing sports sponsorship track record.

wiki.title: Hitachi Energy
wiki.text: Hitachi Energy Ltd. is a technology company headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. The company's products include high-voltage equipment, transformers, and services for renewable energy.

about: World Kinect Corporation, formerly World Fuel Services, is a Miami-based global energy management company that supplies and trades fuel for aviation, marine and land customers, and also sells power, natural gas and sustainability services. Customers are airlines, shipping lines, military and government agencies, and commercial fleets in about 200 countries. Revenue is tens of billions of dollars, with several thousand employees. Listed on the NYSE (WKC). B2B fuel logistics brand with little consumer profile, though well known in aviation and shipping.

wiki.title: World Kinect Corporation
wiki.text: World Kinect Corporation, formerly known as World Fuel Services Corporation, is an energy, commodities, and services company based in Doral, Florida. The company ranked No. 70 in the 2022 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations. WKC focuses on the marketing, trading, and financing of aviation, marine, building, and ground transportation energy commodities and related services. As of 2013, WKC also operates in natural gas and power.

about: LG Innotek is a South Korean electronic components maker, part of LG Group, producing camera modules for smartphones (including Apple), automotive electronics, semiconductor substrates, LED and driving modules. Customers are mobile phone brands, carmakers and chip companies, with revenue exceeding 15 trillion won. Headquartered in Seoul and listed on the Korea Exchange (011070). Crunchbase shows about 200 million dollars of funding in 2025. B2B component brand, known in the supply chain but not to consumers.

wiki.title: LG Innotek
wiki.text: LG Innotek Co., Ltd., an affiliate of LG Group, is an electronic component manufacturer headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. LG Innotek produces core components of mobile devices, automotive displays, semiconductors, and smart products. Most of the company's revenue is generated from selling camera modules for the iPhone.

about: Chinese consumer electronics group, headquartered in Changsha, Hunan, best known for Anker charging products, plus Soundcore audio, eufy smart home and robot vacuums, Nebula projectors and Ankermake 3D printers, sold through Amazon, retailers and its own sites in over 100 countries. Founded in 2011 by former Google engineer Steven Yang, listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board, with revenue of about CNY 20 billion or more. Strong global consumer brand, especially in online retail, and already sponsors sport and esports.

wiki.title: Anker
wiki.text: Anker Innovations Co., Ltd, commonly known as Anker, is a Chinese electronics manufacturer based in Changsha, Hunan, China. The company's products are phone chargers, car chargers, power banks, earbuds, headphones, speakers, data hubs, 3D printers, charging cables, torches (flashlights), screen protectors, portable power stations, home solar batteries, and smart home devices.

about: JinkoSolar is a leading Chinese solar panel manufacturer, headquartered in Shanghai, with large factories in China, Malaysia, Vietnam and the US, and one of the world's largest shippers of photovoltaic modules, selling its Tiger series of high-efficiency panels to utilities, project developers, distributors and installers in over 100 countries. It is vertically integrated from ingots and wafers to cells and modules, with annual revenue of tens of billions of dollars. Listed on the NYSE (JKS) and Shanghai STAR Market. Large B2B brand that has used sports sponsorship.
flags: last funding 2014: check it is still independent and operating

wiki.title: JinkoSolar
wiki.text: JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. is a solar module manufacturer headquartered in Shanghai, China, and listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 2010. Its subsidiary Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's Science and Technology Innovation Board in 2022.

about: Alcoa is a US aluminium producer, headquartered in Pittsburgh, that mines bauxite, refines alumina and smelts aluminium, with operations in Australia, Brazil, Canada, Spain, Norway and the US. Customers are automotive, aerospace, packaging and construction manufacturers. Founded in 1888 and listed on the NYSE (AA), it has revenue of about 12 billion dollars. B2B commodity supplier with little consumer awareness, though its history in aluminium for cars is known to automakers.

wiki.title: Alcoa
wiki.text: Alcoa Corporation is an American industrial corporation that produces aluminum. According to industry rankings, it is among the largest producers globally. The company operates in 10 countries and is involved in mining, refining, smelting, fabricating, and recycling aluminum products.

about: Newmont is the world's largest gold mining company, headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with mines in the US, Canada, Mexico, Ghana, Australia, Peru and Argentina, and copper, silver and zinc by-products. Revenue is about $19 billion. It acquired Newcrest in 2023. Listed on the NYSE (NEM) and other exchanges. B2B with little consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Newmont
wiki.text: Newmont Corporation is an American gold mining company based in Denver, Colorado. It is the world's largest gold mining corporation. Incorporated in 1921, it holds ownership of gold mines in the United States, Canada, Mexico, the Dominican Republic, Australia, Ghana, Argentina, Peru, and Suriname. Newmont is also a partial owner of Nevada Gold Mines in Nevada with Barrick Mining being the majority owner and operator. In addition to gold, Newmont mines copper, silver, zinc and lead.

about: Nippon Steel is Japan's largest steelmaker, based in Tokyo, producing steel for cars, construction and energy, with operations in Japan, India, Southeast Asia and the US, and revenue of about 8 trillion yen. It acquired US Steel in June 2025 for about $14.9 billion, following a long political fight. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (5401). B2B with little consumer profile.

wiki.title: Nippon Steel
wiki.text: Nippon Steel Corporation is a Japanese steel manufacturing company, headquartered in Marunouchi, Chiyoda, Tokyo. The company has four business segments, which are steelmaking, engineering, chemicals, and systems solutions. It is the largest producer of crude steel in Japan and the fourth largest in the world.

loc: Rio De Janeiro, Rio de Jan...
about: Vale is a Brazilian mining company and one of the world's largest producers of iron ore and iron ore pellets, plus nickel, copper and other base metals, serving steelmakers and industrial customers mainly in China, Asia and Europe. Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, with major operations in Carajas and Minas Gerais and mines in Canada. Founded in 1942 as state-owned Companhia Vale do Rio Doce and privatized in 1997. Listed on the Sao Paulo exchange (VALE3) and the NYSE (VALE). B2B commodity producer with strong Brazilian brand recognition and a history of sports sponsorship in Brazil.

wiki.title: Vale S.A.
wiki.what: Multinational diversified metals and mining corporation
wiki.text: Vale, formerly Companhia Vale do Rio Doce, is a Brazilian multinational corporation engaged in metals and mining and one of the largest logistics operators in Brazil.

about: Vedanta Resources is the London-based holding company of Indian natural resources conglomerate Vedanta Limited, controlled by Anil Agarwal. Its subsidiaries produce zinc, lead, silver, aluminium, copper, iron ore, oil and gas, and power, and are building businesses in steel and electronics; Hindustan Zinc and Cairn Oil & Gas are well known. The group operates mainly in India, with additional assets in South Africa and Namibia, and has carried significant debt that it restructured in recent years. Delisted from the London Stock Exchange in 2018. B2B commodities with modest consumer awareness outside India.

wiki.title: Vedanta Resources
wiki.what: Global diversified metals and mining company
wiki.text: Vedanta Resources Limited is a diversified mining company headquartered in London, England. It is the largest mining and non-ferrous metals company in India and has mining operations in Australia and Zambia and oil and gas operations in three countries. Its main products are zinc, lead, silver, oil and gas, iron ore, steel, aluminium and power. It has also developed commercial power stations in India in Odisha and Punjab.

about: Zijin Mining is China's largest gold and copper miner, with operations in China and around 15 other countries including Serbia, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Tibet, Papua New Guinea and Suriname. It produces gold, copper, zinc, lithium and silver, and is expanding in lithium. Headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian, founded in 1993; listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (601899) and Hong Kong (2899). Revenue is above 40 billion dollars with tens of thousands of employees. Chinese state-linked ownership via Minxi Xinghang. B2B commodity producer with limited consumer brand awareness outside China.

wiki.title: Zijin Mining
wiki.text: Zijin Mining Group Co., Limited is a publicly-traded partly state-owned mining company headquartered in Longyan, Fujian, China. It is one of the largest producers of gold, copper, and zinc in the country, with operations across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.

about: Barrick Mining (formerly Barrick Gold) is a Toronto-based gold and copper miner with major operations including Nevada Gold Mines, Kibali in Congo, Loulo-Gounkoto in Mali and the Reko Diq copper project, producing around 4 million ounces of gold annually. Customers are bullion and metals buyers. It renamed to Barrick Mining in 2025 and trades on NYSE and TSX (B, ABX). A global resources brand with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Barrick Mining
wiki.text: Barrick Mining Corporation is a mining company that produces gold and copper. It has mining operations and projects in Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chile, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Egypt, Jamaica, Mali, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Peru, Saudi Arabia, Senegal, Tanzania, the United States and Zambia.

about: Nexans is a French cable and electrification company, based in Courbevoie near Paris and listed on Euronext Paris, that makes power cables for utilities and offshore wind, high-voltage subsea interconnectors, building cables and industrial and automotive cables. It has about 28,000 employees in over 40 countries and revenue of around 6-7 billion euros. Customers are power grid operators, construction firms and manufacturers. Founded in 2000 from Alcatel's cable business. B2B industrial supplier with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Nexans
wiki.what: French copper and optical fibre cable company
wiki.text: Nexans S.A. is a global company in the cable and optical fibre industry headquartered in Paris, France.

about: Novelis is the world's largest producer of flat-rolled aluminum products and the largest recycler of aluminum, based in Atlanta, Georgia and owned by India's Hindalco Industries. It sells sheet and plate to makers of beverage cans, car bodies and speciality products, with plants across North America, Europe, Asia and South America and revenue of about $16-17 billion. Its main customers include beverage companies and automakers. B2B industrial company with limited consumer brand recognition.

wiki.title: Novelis
wiki.text: Novelis Inc. is an American industrial aluminum smelting company, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, United States. It produces rolled aluminum and is an aluminum recycler, supplying to sectors including beverage cans, automotive, aerospace, consumer electronics, construction, foil and packaging.

about: ArcelorMittal is the world's second-largest steelmaker, headquartered in Luxembourg and listed in Europe and New York (MT). It produces steel for car, construction and packaging customers, with operations in about 60 countries, around 125,000 staff and revenue of about $60 billion. Controlled by the Mittal family. B2B but a well-known industrial name in many countries, and a past sponsor of London Olympics tower.

wiki.title: ArcelorMittal
wiki.text: ArcelorMittal S.A., headquartered in Luxembourg City, is a multinational steel manufacturing corporation, with operations in iron ore and coke mining as well as scrap recycling. It is the second-largest steelmaker worldwide behind Baowu and was the largest steelmaker worldwide until 2019, when Baowu acquired other Chinese steelmakers.
